Integrated, inclusive/gender-responsive, sustainable urban planning Contractor will facilitate the integration of various urban planning components like land use, transportation, infrastructure, environment, social development, economic development, and financial planning including gender-responsive approaches, climate resilience, disaster risk management, to ensure a holistic approach. The contractor will also be responsible for economic development, financial planning and attracting investments through marketing to ensure holistic growth of the city. 3.
